answer: By the tide of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, burned when the recruit misbehaves. The ripple is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the forge.
